_comment: Copy to builder/api_access_points/config.json (gitignored) and fill in. JSON has no comments, so docs live in _comment fields and README.md.

controllers._comment: Each Catalyst 9800 to pull APs from. An AP records the controller it was found on. List every controller in the estate; APs are keyed by serial, so an AP that roams between controllers updates one card rather than creating two.

_site_comment: Regex pulling a site code out of the AP name; the named group `site` wins, else group 1. APs that don't match fall back to the AP's location as configured on the controller — pin those down in ../overrides.json.
